title: fix(plugin-view): an object-view grid exports the filter it shows and returns to page 1 when it changes (objectui#11880 item 5)
body:
Fixes #11880

Clause-②: no — `ObjectView` changes which slot of the grid node it builds for its own `ObjectGrid` carries the filter. No published type, zod accept set, export or prop moves: `ObjectGridSchema.defaultFilters` stays declared on both faces while the pinned spec (17.7.0) declares it.

Item 5 of this card, its last item: `object-grid.defaultFilters` and `ObjectView`'s hand-off. Claim `6068695486`; the seat's answer `6068966481` (Q1 → A, Q2 → A1) to the needs_decision report `6068935827`. Ruling of record: objectstack-ai/objectstack#11509 `6051498447` (A-narrow; objectui first, and the spec retirement ships with the pin bump that carries it).

## Which of the two, and why

Item 5 asked to retire the mirror key or to retarget the internal hand-off to `filter`, and to say which. This PR **retargets the hand-off**. The mirror key, `ObjectGrid`'s read of it and `ObjectView`'s read of an authored `table.defaultFilters` stay while the pinned spec still declares the key; under the ruling's order they retire with the pin bump that carries the spec half. After this PR objectui's own code writes `defaultFilters` into no node (census below), so that retirement blanks nothing objectui builds, and the bump deletes readers only.

## User-visible corrections

Both on an `object-view` rendered by the registered renderer (route 2: an `object-view` page node, the Studio's stored-view preview). A host that supplies `renderListView` (route 1, `ListView`) already behaved this way.

- **The export carries the view's filter.** A named view's filter and an authored `table.defaultFilters` narrowed the rows on screen, but `ObjectGrid`'s server-streamed export (CSV, XLSX, JSON) reads only the `filter` slot, so it was handed no filter and downloaded every record of the object. It now downloads the rows the view shows, as it already did for `table.filter`.
- **Changing the filter returns the grid to page 1.** `ObjectGrid`'s page reset keys only on the `filter` slot, so when a named view's filter or `table.defaultFilters` changed while the grid stayed mounted, the next query kept the old page index. It now returns to page 1, as `table.filter` already did.

Unchanged: which filter applies (every rung and pair sends the same `$filter` and draws the same rows), and a refused filter still draws the grid's malformed-filter panel and queries nothing.

## What changed

- `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx`, the grid branch: `filter: viewFilter || gridTableFilterRung(authoredFilters)`; the `defaultFilters` write is gone. `gridTableFilterRung` returns `table.filter` unless it lowers to nothing, else `table.defaultFilters`. "Lowers to nothing" is the sink's own answer (`toFilterNodeSafely` from `@object-ui/core`), which is the choice `ObjectGrid` made itself while the two arrived in two slots, so an empty `table.filter` beside a `table.defaultFilters` keeps the grid's answer (Q2 → A1). A refused `table.filter` is kept, so the grid still draws its panel. The named view's filter keeps today's truthiness (`||`): an empty named-view filter still filters nothing.
- Comments: the `objectui#5102` paragraph above the memo no longer says the filter pair is forwarded in both slots, and the memo comment that said `ObjectGrid` "raw-assigns the legacy one" (false since objectui#4082; round 10's acceptance note named this PR's memo as its carrier) is replaced.
- Pins: the measurement instrument becomes `ObjectView.gridFilterHandoff-11880.test.tsx` (18 tests, real `ObjectView`, real `ObjectGrid`, a `ValueDataSource` that applies `$filter`). Four `plugin-view` pins that asserted `grid.defaultFilters` are re-spelled to `grid.filter` plus `grid.defaultFilters` undefined: `ObjectView.canonicalTableKeys`, `ObjectView.namedViewContextTokens-10506`, `ObjectView.specShapedNamedView-8254`, `ObjectView.tableSlotRelay-10976` (its by-name loop skips `defaultFilters`, whose arrival in `filter` is pinned by a new case).
- Docs: in `packages/plugin-view/README.md` and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-view.mdx`, the sentence saying `ObjectView` defers to `ObjectGrid` "by forwarding both slots" now covers the paging pairs only and states the filter pair's resolution and its two effects.
- Two sentences this change made false, fixed under the claim amendment `6069594612`, as comment / TSDoc only: the `ObjectGridSchema.defaultFilters` docblock in `packages/types/src/objectql.ts`, and `ObjectGrid.tsx`'s legacy-read comment. Each now says that `ObjectView` hands its whole filter chain to `filter`, and no longer writes `defaultFilters`.
- `.changeset/11880-grid-filter-handoff.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-view` patch, naming both corrections.

## Measurement

**H1, the hand-off before** (base `aa67386a5`, instrument at `601aeaf67`, 17 of 17 green). Rows Acme/open, Beta/won, Cyan/lost, Dune/open; the view rule matches open, `table.filter` won, `table.defaultFilters` lost. None: no `$filter`, four rows. View: open, Acme and Dune. `table.filter`: won, Beta. `table.defaultFilters`: lost, Cyan. View with either or both table rungs: open. `table.filter` with `table.defaultFilters`: won. Empty view filter beside both table rungs: no `$filter`, four rows. Refinement of H1: `ObjectGrid` read `defaultFilters` when `filter` LOWERED to nothing, not only when it was absent (`table.filter: []` beside `table.defaultFilters` drew lost/Cyan).

**H2, one slot.** It did not hold as worded: `ObjectGrid` treats the slots differently in exactly two readers beyond the base filter, the server export and the page-reset effect (both read `filter` only; `$select` collectors, grouped queries, select-all-matching and the count all derive from the one query the load effect builds). The report stopped there; the seat ruled the two changed answers corrections. A naive `||` chain would also have changed the empty-canonical pair; the faithful chain keeps it.

**H3, census** (populations enumerated with `git ls-tree` on HEAD: packages 6325, apps 349, examples 513, content 203, docs 25, skills 27 files). Write-shaped `defaultFilters` keys (a quoted key allowed) outside tests and CHANGELOGs, before this PR: 7 hits, exactly one of which wrote a node, `ObjectView`'s grid branch; the rest are `ObjectGrid`'s resolver input and interface member, an `ObjectGrid` comment, the zod declaration and the two documentation rows teaching it as legacy. apps, examples, docs, skills: 0 (matcher control on examples: `objectName` keys, 36 hits, same regex shape). After this PR the node writer is gone. Authored metadata with `table.defaultFilters` still renders through the readers that stay (pinned: rung 3 alone, rungs 2 + 3, the empty-canonical pair).

**H4, docs.** The one sentence describing the hand-off is rewritten (above); the three-tier precedence paragraph stays true.

## Tests

On head `d9f895bd9`, every vitest run under `os-verify-lock`. The patch round `c8cf0365` (the two sentences above) re-ran the `plugin-view`, `plugin-grid` and `packages/types` suites, plus every test that reads `objectql.ts` or `ObjectGrid.tsx` from disk: 647 files, 13494 tests, all passing. Type-check for `types`, `plugin-grid` and `plugin-view` exits 0. The merges of `main` that followed touched none of this PR's files, and the net diff's `git patch-id --stable` is unchanged (`39130482`).

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-view/ packages/plugin-grid/ apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/filter-source-merge.test.ts packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.exportMatchesView.test.tsx packages/types/src/__tests__/grid-default-filters-gantt-map-filter-round10-6152.test.ts` (both whole suites, plus every test outside them that names `defaultFilters`, `tableDefaults` or `useResolvedGridFilters`): `Test Files  269 passed (269)`, `Tests  2858 passed (2858)`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 scripts/__tests__/`: `Test Files  179 passed | 2 skipped (181)`, `Tests  5452 passed | 2 skipped (5454)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-view type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid type-check` (both script names echoed), exit 0, after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/console^...' --filter='@object-ui/example-schema-catalog^...'`. `tsconfig.test.json` lists all five edited test files (`--listFilesOnly`, 5 of 5).
- `pnpm check:doc-snippets` (784 of 784 blocks judged, 0 failed), `pnpm check:readme-exports` (579 of 579 self-imports real), `pnpm docs:check-links`, all exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` (6 source files of 1 released package, 1 changeset), `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `pnpm check:changeset-claims`, `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`, `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `pnpm check:control-bytes`, all exit 0.
- ESLint over the 6 changed TypeScript files: 0 errors (warnings pre-existing; none in the new pin file or the edited regions).
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the 9 paths: NOT GOVERNED.

**Ablations** (one-shot, objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode; each mutation proven on disk, each restored to the `HEAD` blob with an empty `git diff HEAD`), over the pin file and the four re-spelled pins (80 tests):

- **Two-slot hand-off restored** (the base's `defaultFilters` / `filter` pair): **12 red / 68 green**. In the pin file exactly the four corrected rows go red with their before-readings (export of a named-view filter and of `table.defaultFilters`: `expected undefined to deeply equal` the lowered rule; page reset after an in-place change of either: `expected 2 to be +0`), while the ten rung rows, the two controls and both refusal rows stay green. The other 8 are the re-spelled `grid.filter` / `grid.defaultFilters` assertions in the four pins.
- **A refused `table.filter` skipped** (`canonical.ok && …`): 1 red, `a refused table.filter is kept, not skipped for table.defaultFilters`.
- **Naive chain** (`viewFilter || table || tableDefaults`): 1 red, `an EMPTY table.filter lowers to nothing, so table.defaultFilters answers`.

## Bundle

`check:eager-closure` under the lock, on this tree merged with `main` `7ebff399` (green on `Bundle Analysis`, after objectui#12009's revert and objectui#12004), and on that `main` alone:

- `main` `7ebff399`: `eagerGzipBytes` 3,391,414;
- this tree: 3,391,439 (identical on a second build);
- **delta +25 B**, leaving 45 B of headroom under the 3,391,484 B ceiling.

The ceiling constant is untouched.

## Acceptance notes

- An authored `object-grid` node's own `defaultFilters` is still skipped by `ObjectGrid`'s export and page reset (`ObjectGrid` reads only `filter` there). No author writes one (census 0), and the read retires with the key. Carrier: the v18 pin-bump PR.
- The grid and the non-grid routes still disagree on an empty `table.filter` beside a `table.defaultFilters` (the grid applies the legacy rule; the calendar route queries nothing, measured). Kept by Q2 → A1; no author; it goes with the legacy read.
